get.description: Sets the csrftoken cookie. The admin app sends its value back in the X-CSRFToken header on every write.

delete.description: Soft delete: hide from the shop, keep rows so past orders still resolve.

get.description: Every price change of this product's sizes, newest first. Who changed it and when.

post.description: Adds a photo at the end of the gallery. The first photo is the one customers see in the grid.

put.description: Set the gallery order. Must list every photo of this product exactly once; the first one becomes the main photo.

get.description: Every category, hidden ones and empty ones included (the public list hides those).

post.description: Stop a running promotion now. Keeps the record (orders already store the name and price they were sold at).
Stop the code now. Orders that already used it keep their discount.

delete.description: Only drafts can be deleted. Anything that was shown to customers stays on record.

post.description: Stops a live campaign now. On a scheduled one it cancels the schedule. Its time is kept for the record.
A still image (JPG, PNG, WebP) or an animation (GIF, animated WebP). An animation gets a still poster made from its first frame.
The hero video (MP4 or WebM). The poster is uploaded separately: it is what shows before the video loads.
A vertical version for phones. Optional: without it, phones play the main video.
A still picture (JPG, PNG or WebP) shown before a video loads, on slow connections, or when motion is reduced.
A new draft with the same look, text, products and media, moved one year later. Typical for a festival that repeats yearly.

get.description: Per campaign: orders, goods sold, and how many customers pressed its hero button.

post.description: A short-lived token the shop accepts to show this campaign before it goes live.

get.description: The campaign to show now. With a valid preview token, that campaign even if it is a draft.

The hero button. Counts one press for a campaign that is live now, then sends the customer on.
No cookies and no personal data: only the count goes up.

post.description: Find an order by number + the phone used to place it. Same 404 for any mismatch, and guessing is throttled.
Get (or create) the PromptPay QR for this order.

put.description: LINE group that gets this place's warehouse alerts. Empty = the shared staff group.
Daily online quota and own low-stock line for one size at one branch.

post.description: The counter sold the rest: stop online sales for this size at this branch now.
Check a stock file and show what would change. Nothing is written.
Counter sales for the day, taken off the shelf at this branch.
Choose which branch's stock fills a delivery order. Pickup orders always use the branch the customer picked.

get.description: Payment slips are private. They are stored outside the public /media paths and only served here to logged-in staff.
Counts of things waiting for action. Visible to every staff member (no money figures).
